name: Korea Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 1957 and headquartered in Busan, South Korea, Korea Industrial Co., Ltd. specializes in the production and distribution of specialized nutritional feeds. Their comprehensive product line caters to a wide range of animals, including poultry (such as laying hens and broilers), various livestock like pigs, dairy cattle, other bovine species, ducks, rabbits, black goats, and even canine breeds such as sheepdogs, among others.
